5063536259996.baseName: Height Lighting Tabletop Artificial Christmas Tree with Rustic Log Base Plain 45cm
5063536259996.variantName: Height Lighting Tabletop Artificial Christmas Tree with Rustic Log Base Plain 45cm
5063536259996.sourceDescription:
Not every room has space for a full-size tree, but every room deserves a bit of Christmas. This little tabletop tree brings all the festive feeling to a sideboard, desk or bedside table, with lush green branches sitting on a rustic log base that gives it a cosy, natural look.

It comes in two heights, 45cm or 60cm, so you can pick the size that fits your space. The branches are full and bushy and can be bent and fluffed out to shape, and the bark-edged log base keeps it steady wherever you put it.

You can also choose whether you want it plain or with warm white LED lights already wrapped through the branches. The lit version glows beautifully in the evening, just like candlelight, and runs on 3 x AAA batteries, which aren’t included, so there are no wires to hide. The plain version is perfect for decorating your own way with mini baubles, ribbon or a little star on top.

It’s lovely on a mantelpiece, windowsill, kitchen worktop or office desk, or in a bedroom, flat or anywhere short on space. Pop a couple of different sizes together for a mini festive forest, and keep it out right through the season.
Small tree height: 45cm
Large tree height: 60cm
Base: Log with bark edge
Lit tree lights: Warm white LED
Lit tree batteries: 3 x AAA (not included)

Artificial Christmas Tree
This artificial Christmas tree adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The green finish and plastic and metal construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Pine Cone Detail
Pine cone details add texture among the festive foliage. Their recognisable shapes help create a woodland inspired arrangement, making the decoration easy to coordinate with other natural looking Christmas accessories.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Product details

Durable plastic and metal construction ensures a defined appearance and long-lasting seasonal use.
Versatile green finish complements woodland-inspired arrangements and coordinates with natural accessories.
Lightweight design at just 1.2kg makes it easy to position as a focal point on shelves or tables.

Elevate every corner of your home effortlessly with this snow-flocked Christmas tree.

5051641562896.sourceDescription:
If you're looking for the ideal real Christmas tree, the Noble Fir is up there with the best you can buy. Well known for it's bright green needles that display a bluish-hue with a lovely scent, providing extremely attractive foliage that won't drop it's needles. The hardy upright branches allow for even the heaviest ornaments to be easily supported. Caring for this tree doesn't require much effort, it really only needs water to keep it going, although this will be required often. Make sure when watering that the soil is not waterlogged, and do not allow the container to dry out. Once the christmas period is over, you can transfer the tree into your garden, you can leave it in the container it is supplied in but we recommend you re-pot the tree into a larger pot to accommodate it's growth. The root system that develops within the pot will allow this tree to live for years provided it is given the right level of care. Keep it outside as close to christmas as possible, and when it is time to bring the tree inside, keep it away from sources of heat such as radiators or fireplaces, these will dry the tree out and quickly cause it to drop it's needles. As we ship these staple Trees directly to you from our premesis this guarantees the life and quality of the tree you will receive as you know it won't be bashed around in travel. It's going from us, to you!
PREMIUM QUALITY, FRESH FROM THE FARM - GardenersDream Christmas Trees are British grown and cared for year-round by our expert team
REAL LIVING CHRISTMAS TREE - Can be placed outside in the garden after Christmas and can be used repeatedly, eliminating the need to keep buying new trees.
HARDY, ATTRACTIVE FIR - Sports impressive greenish-blue foliage, branches develop upright which helps support heavier ornaments, ideal non-needle drop variety
POT GROWN, EASY TO CARE FOR AND MAINTAIN - With regular watering and occasional feeding, these trees will last a long time. Little pruning is required, just the ocassional trim to keep it's shape

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

8956086258496.baseName: Red Christmas Cupboard Ribbon Bows 8 Pack 200 cm Polyester Festive Kitchen Door Wall and Wreath Decorations
8956086258496.variantName: Red Christmas Cupboard Ribbon Bows 8 Pack 200 cm Polyester Festive Kitchen Door Wall and Wreath Decorations
8956086258496.sourceDescription:
Turn everyday cupboard doors into part of your Christmas display with this set of eight red ribbon bows. Each bow measures approximately 200 cm (78.7 in) in total length, with a bow head of around 28 cm (11 in), so one bow is wide enough to wrap across a standard cupboard door and still catch the eye. Eight pieces are supplied, which is enough to dress a full run of kitchen cupboards and keep a spare for replacements.

Fitting takes only a minute. Two adhesive pads come with each bow: one is sewn onto the side of the bow and the second is applied by hand. Place the self-adhesive pad on the cupboard door, press the two pads together and adjust the ribbon until the bow sits exactly where you want it. Because the pads are separate from the door surface, the design suits cupboard doors of almost any size and shape, with no tools, nails or drilling needed. Keep the adhesive side clean and free of dust before fitting so the pads hold firmly, and avoid stretching the ribbon while pressing.

The bows are made from polyester with a smooth, soft finish and neat stitching. The fabric is lightweight, does not crease easily and holds its colour without fading, so the bows can be packed away flat and reused Christmas after Christmas. If a bow arrives flattened from transit, a quick press with a cool iron restores its shape without damaging the material.

As well as kitchen cupboards, the bows work on doors, hallways, walls, fences, trees, wreaths, table tops and craft projects, turning plain surfaces into something that looks like a wrapped present. The deep red shade is a classic festive colour that sits well with garlands, baubles and ribbon on a wreath, making this pack a simple way to add Christmas colour to a kitchen, hallway or porch.
Guarantee - 1 month

5056928934496.sourceDescription:
Bring a nostalgic winter wonderland to your home with this light up Christmas village candle arch from MySmartBuy. Inspired by traditional European candle arches, it frames a charming festive scene of snowy-roofed cottages, a little church with a cross on its spire, fir trees, a snowman with a top hat and star, and a family out for a winter stroll. The arch is decorated with cut-out stars and topped with lantern-style lights, and the scene is illuminated by eight LEDs that give a warm, cosy glow, making the little village look as though it is lit for Christmas Eve. The base is finished with cut-out stars, snowflakes, bells and holly, along with gold painted detail. Measuring 19 x 28cm, it is a lovely size for windowsills, mantelpieces, sideboards and shelves. Placed in a window, its glow can be seen from outside, just like the traditional candle arches of Germany and Scandinavia. It is battery operated, so there are no trailing cables, and the built-in timer switches the lights on and off automatically. It requires 2 x AA batteries, which are not included. A heart-warming festive keepsake to bring out every year, and a lovely Christmas gift for anyone who loves traditional, Scandi or Alpine-style decor. At a glance: Christmas village candle arch | cottages, church, trees, snowman and family scene | 8 LEDs | gold painted detail | timer | battery operated, 2 x AA (not included) | 19 x 28cm.

8 LEDS – Illuminated with eight LEDs.
GOLD PAINTED DETAIL – Elegant finishing touches.
TIMER INCLUDED – Lights switch on and off automatically.
BATTERY OPERATED – Requires 2 x AA batteries, not included. Measures 19 x 28cm.

5096042276096.sourceDescription:
A bow and small bells set a traditional tone against the pine cones on this 50 cm wreath. The scale suits a front door, where the bow is visible from a distance and the smaller ornaments can be enjoyed up close. It can be used indoors or outdoors, so the same decoration can move between a hallway and an entrance as your plans change.

A wreath puts the decoration on the door or wall itself, leaving the console or mantelpiece below free for cards and winter flowers. Its outline is complete in one piece, which is handy in an entrance where there is little space for a tree. From a few steps away the cones read as dark accents. Closer up, their overlapping scales contrast with the finer foliage. A simple ribbon or a nearby wooden decoration will pick up that woodland detail.

For a simpler finish, keep additional decorations to one part of the ring and let the natural shape of the foliage show elsewhere. A ribbon tied off-centre can pick up a colour from the tree without covering the sprigs. The centre opening lets the background play a part in the design. Pale paint gives the foliage a sharp outline, while a darker panel draws attention to the texture at the tips of the branches.

If you plan to use the wreath in a group, set it out with your other decorations before you hang them. A little breathing room around its edge usually shows the shapes more clearly than placing several pieces edge to edge. After the festive season, lay the decoration in a box with space around its edges. Keep heavy ornaments and tightly coiled strings of lights separate so that the front of the wreath keeps its shape in storage.

Hung on a panelled door, a wreath looks best when the edges of the panel still show. Centre it on the panel itself and look at it from the far end of the hall before choosing the final hanging height.
Traditional festive design featuring rustic bells, pine cones and a decorative bow for classic holiday charm.
Versatile indoor and outdoor decoration suitable for front doors, hallways or mantelpieces throughout the season.
Compact 50 cm diameter size provides a complete decorative statement without overwhelming smaller entrance spaces.
Crafted with artificial greenery that maintains its shape and appearance year after year with minimal maintenance.

Christmas Decoration
This Christmas decoration adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The gold finish and polyester construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Product details
Material: Polyester. Colour: Gold. Stated size: 25.5 x 25.5 x 35 cm. Product weight: 1 kg. Quantity: 3 pack.

Compact dimensions of 25.5 x 25.5 x 35 cm suit various indoor arrangements.

Create a cosy festive atmosphere with the Three Kings InLit Father Christmas. Featuring a traditional red Santa design and 16 warm white LEDs, this charming illuminated Christmas decoration adds a welcoming seasonal glow to your home.

Available in Large and Jumbo sizes too, the Three Kings InLit Father Christmas range makes it easy to find the right size for your home and seasonal display.

Inflatable Santa
This inflatable santa adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The white and red finish and fabric construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Father Christmas Motif
A Father Christmas motif gives the design a recognisable festive character. It brings a seasonal focal point to the arrangement and can be paired with other Christmas decorations to create a consistent theme across the display.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Product details
Material: Fabric. Colour: White and Red. Stated size: 140 x 75 x 215 cm. Quantity: 1 piece.

Fabric construction in white and red provides a defined appearance suitable for indoor or outdoor decoration.

Designed to coordinate with existing colour schemes and textures for a consistent Christmas theme.
